answer: Anchor each agent identity to a slashable stake locked for a season, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs thousands of separate stakes and the attack price grows linearly. Honest reputation then accrues slowly, like an orchard maturing over seasons, and cannot be moved to a fresh identity. A verified registry keeps the shared record calm, like a lagoon, by revoking the stake of any identity caught double-voting, which makes Sybil farming unprofitable.
